value.rationale: The canonically determined 234 minimal projective quadrangle two-spheres span a nonprimitive index-27 sublattice in a natural rank-168 matroid homology group, creating exactly three independent integral 3-torsion classes after attaching all quadrangle tetrahedra. This genuinely integral obstruction is not implied by the previously known sphere-wedge homotopy type of a matroid independence complex or by rational ranks and supplies a motivated complete classification for the smallest nonbinary projective plane.
